verdict: GBP visibility dropped sharply this week; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your Google Business Profile listings were the sole source of inbound engagement, generating a combined 383 actions (18 calls, 270 direction requests, 95 web clicks) over the last 28 days. In the final 7 days of this window, GBP activity fell sharply — dropping between 54% and 100% depending on the entity — a pattern consistent across all profiles and pointing to a listing visibility or algorithm event rather than isolated issues. Organic search clicks moved in the same direction, reinforcing that this is a visibility problem, not a demand problem. We are actively investigating the GBP listings for suppression or algorithm changes and will address the root cause this week. With paid channels not yet running, restoring GBP visibility is the immediate priority before the next reporting period.
